verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's official MCP server and REST API require API-token or OAuth authentication (pagerduty-probe-rt-1, pagerduty-docs-32/39/44), which implies some credential-based access control an agent could use, but the evidence never describes granular scopes, roles, or least-privilege permission tiers specifically for AI-agent credentials. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped/role-based API keys or OAuth scopes for agent use, any read-only vs write-restricted key options, and confirmation these can be issued distinctly per-agent.
